sst.description: Stock k-omega SST of OpenFOAM v2312 (baseline).

invariant.description: Invariant correction (Sec. II): final equation of the invariant search, round 16.

flow_state.description: Flow-state correction (Sec. III): selected equation of the flow-state search.

rotation_limited.description: Rotation-limited correction (Sec. III B3, adopted): flow-state correction with the rotation term multiplied by tanh(Rf/0.01).

shielded_S2.description: Shielded variant S2 (Sec. III B3, not adopted): rotation-limited correction with the excess-production term multiplied by (1-F1)^2

shielded_S4.description: Shielded variant S4 (Sec. III B3, not adopted): rotation-limited correction with the excess-production term multiplied by (1-F1)^4

shielded_S8.description: Shielded variant S8 (Sec. III B3, not adopted): rotation-limited correction with the excess-production term multiplied by (1-F1)^8

shielded_T1.description: Shielded variant T1 (Sec. III B3, not adopted): rotation-limited correction with the activation threshold of the excess-production term raised by 1

qcr2000.description: QCR2000 (Spalart 2000; Sec. V, compared closure): quadratic constitutive relation on the SST stress, C_cr1 = 0.3.
